tasks.label: Dev: build container image
tasks.command: bash -lc 'if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman compose -f compose.yaml build dev; elif command -v podman-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman-compose -f compose.yaml build dev; elif command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose -f compose.yaml build dev; else echo "Install podman or docker with compose support" && exit 1; fi'

tasks.label: Dev: start container
tasks.command: bash -lc 'if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman compose -f compose.yaml up -d dev; elif command -v podman-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman-compose -f compose.yaml up -d dev; elif command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose -f compose.yaml up -d dev; else echo "Install podman or docker with compose support" && exit 1; fi'
